description: Manage Google Tasks the way agents work: task-shaped tools that finish in one call. Lists and tasks are found by ID or by title (resolved inside the connector), so adding, completing, moving, or editing a task never needs a separate lookup first.

inputs.description: Where the API is; it must be allowed below
inputs.name: api_base
inputs.title: API base URL

instructions: Lists and tasks resolve by ID or title — pass whichever you have. Complete tasks with completeTask rather than deleting them; use moveTask to reorder or reparent. clearCompletedTasks is destructive, so prefer completing tasks individually when the list itself matters.
